lead: A Minnehaha County city about 12 miles west of Sioux Falls, just off I-90.
living:
Hartford is in Minnehaha County, about 12 miles west of Sioux Falls, with 3,406 people at the 2020 Census. It's the main town in the West Central School District, which also covers Humboldt, the Wall Lake area and Hartford Heights.

I-90 runs just south of town, so getting to the west side of Sioux Falls and the I-29 junction is quick.
know: What to know before you buy in Hartford

• In town or out of town: listings with a Hartford address include homes in city limits and homes on acreage around Wall Lake and Hartford Heights. Septic, wells and road upkeep can differ.
  • Commute: about 15–20 minutes to the west side of Sioux Falls.
  • Property taxes: Hartford is in Minnehaha County, and the West Central School District levy is part of the bill.
schools: Hartford is served by the West Central School District. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
faq:
What county is Hartford in?

Hartford is in Minnehaha County. Property taxes are set by Minnehaha County, the city and the local school district.

What school district serves Hartford?

Hartford is served by the West Central School District, which also covers Humboldt and the Wall Lake area. Always confirm the district for a specific address.

How far is Hartford from Sioux Falls?

Hartford is about 12 miles west of Sioux Falls, with I-90 just south of town. Plan on about 15–20 minutes to the west side of Sioux Falls.

Can I get down payment help to buy in Hartford?

Often, yes. South Dakota Housing programs, including Give Me Five, can be used for homes in Hartford if you and the home qualify. Income and price limits apply. See the down payment help options.
